name: Tractogram clustering
summary: Clusters a large tractogram by embedding streamlines with an orientation-invariant dissimilarity to prototype fibres and running MiniBatch K-Means, outputting one medoid streamline per cluster.
description: Resamples the streamlines, embeds each one as its MDF distances to a set of prototype streamlines chosen by farthest-first traversal (Olivetti dissimilarity projection), clusters the embedding with MiniBatch K-Means and selects a real streamline (medoid) per cluster. Use it to compress a very large tractogram into a representative set of streamlines. A reference image is needed to write the output with the right spatial header.

inputs.description: Reference anatomical image defining the tractogram's space, used for format conversion and headers.

outputs.description: Tractogram with one medoid (representative real streamline) per cluster.

parameters.description: Number of MiniBatch K-Means clusters, i.e. the number of medoid streamlines in the output.
Number of parallel jobs; -1 uses all available cores.

Randomly subsample the input tractogram to a fixed number of streamlines. This is useful for debugging and reducing runtime on large datasets. Note that subsampling may affect clustering quality and reproducibility.
